notes: Model is GR-250N-4 (Korean-market spec sheet; Tadano Korea page now also shows GR-250N-5). Table: 定格総荷重表, アウトリガ最大張出(6.6m) 全周, boom. Capacities are rated TOTAL loads including slings and main hook mass (220 kg) per note 1 on p.4; radii include boom deflection. Only 4 boom lengths are tabulated in source (fully synchronized 4-section boom). outriggerSpan_m lists all X-type outrigger extension widths from spec (max 6.6, mid 6.1/5.0/3.6, min 3.1 m); only the 6.6 m chart is included here. operatingWeight_t = 차량총중량 (GVW) 25,595 kg. maxHookHeight_m = boom max 지상양정 31.3 m (jib 44.2 m). maxOutriggerForce_t = 최대잭키반력 boom 26.9 t (jib 17.7 t). Counterweight not stated in the document. Max boom radius 27.9 m. DIMS: carrier length 7,810 mm (bumper to rear; overall transport length incl. boom overhang 11,530 mm); front axle 1,760 mm behind carrier front, wheelbase 3,880 mm, rear overhang 2,170 mm (p.8); slewing centre 3,655 mm from carrier front (3,655+4,155=7,810, p.6); boom foot pin 2,600 mm behind slewing centre (p.6, end of 9,350 mm boom dimension); tail swing R3,100 mm (p.6 plan view). wheelDiameter_m computed from tyre size 385/95R25 (635+2x365.75 mm = 1.367 m), not drawn. boomPivotHeight left null (height dims on p.6 are referenced to jacked-up outrigger level and the foot-pin height is not unambiguously labelled).
